nodes.label: Zero-Tolerance Layout Engine
nodes.rationale: Weighted obstacle maps, candidate scanning, shrink-on-crowding, capacity accountant; nothing overlapping reaches the screen. 'The model proposes; the engine disposes.'

nodes.label: Deterministic Diagram Specialist
nodes.rationale: Known teaching families compile hand-authored diagram ops instead of asking the LLM to freehand coordinates.

nodes.label: Composite Op Vocabulary
nodes.rationale: Model emits one composite op (e.g. polygon with side_labels) and geometry is computed deterministically, since LLMs freehanding 2D coordinates do geometry without eyes.

nodes.label: Structured Inspectable Whiteboard Operations
nodes.rationale: Keep drawing as structured ops rather than image-model pictures: the LLM handles pedagogy and visual reasoning while deterministic code guarantees legibility, timing, and recovery.

nodes.label: Lesson Preparation and Publishing Workflow
nodes.rationale: Sections are reviewed/approved in order and explicitly published; student playback uses saved text, diagrams and audio without calling the lesson model.

nodes.label: tutori-board-gemma LoRA Artist
nodes.rationale: Retired after live A/B: artist never sees researched facts and serialized the turn past the GPU window.

nodes.label: tutori-board-nemotron LoRA Artist
nodes.rationale: Cannot run on ZeroGPU: Mamba-2 layers need fused mamba-ssm Triton kernels that cannot JIT within the 59s budget.

nodes.label: Whisper Large V3 Turbo
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Nemotron ASR, which crashed ZeroGPU workers or took 57.1s to restore per turn.

nodes.label: Fine-tune Honestly, Let the Boring Pipeline Win
nodes.norm_label: fine-tune honestly, let the boring pipeline win

nodes.label: Cumulative Streaming Payloads
nodes.rationale: Gradio coalesces rapid generator yields, dropping lesson steps; every payload made cumulative and the browser deduplicates.

nodes.label: Higgs Audio v2 Voice
nodes.rationale: Higgs v3 needs SGLang-Omni on a persistent GPU, so v2 in transformers was used.

nodes.label: Gradio :has() CSS Selector Gotcha
nodes.rationale: Gradio's CSS preprocessor drops :has() selectors and everything after; tag elements with a class from JavaScript instead.

nodes.label: Line Protocol for Small Models
nodes.rationale: Small models fail at nested JSON and parrot few-shot examples; a PROFILE/NEXT1-3 line protocol with one regex per line and anti-parroting guards made MiniCPM reliable.
